title: Vibe Coding Best Practices: 7 Rules That Prevent Hitting the Wall
summary: Vibe coding works — until it doesn't. These 7 guardrails prevent the most common failure modes: lost context, broken data, auth chaos, and scope creep. Updated for 2026.
body_markdown: Three signals: (1) You need custom integrations with systems that have no natural-language description — legacy enterprise APIs, complex compliance requirements, hardware interfaces. (2) The app is production-critical and needs formal testing, CI/CD, and audit trails a developer manages. (3) You've validated the product and are scaling beyond what a single-person iteration loop can handle. For most MVP validation and internal tool use cases, vibe coding with Blink gets you to the decision point faster than hiring first.
